digest.component_or_area: plan-review criteria vocabulary and store migration
propositions: The plan vocabulary carries two heading names (Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria) for a single concept, with all criteria gates pooling them under one bar, making the split vestigial and harmful

Success Criteria items are written as plain bullets and do not count toward P1 blocking floor, cannot carry [operator-attested] tags, and are not individually checkable, tightening the gate if collapsed to AC checkboxes
Store contains 106 tickets carrying ## Success Criteria headings that must be migrated to ## Acceptance Criteria with criteria converted from plain bullets to - [ ] checklist items

Collapse must occur across detector regexes, reviewer prompts, criteria routing index, author guides, generated criteria guide, eval specs, test corpus, and live tickets, while maintaining exclusions for dod_uncertifiable vocabulary, T2 pilot-metrics phrase, O-RAN-SC vendor term, and frozen test fixtures

Post-migration grep validation must return zero SC heading vocabulary matches in live source except at four permanent carve-out sites (plan_review_T2.md, plan_review_verifier.md, plan_review_verifier_agentic.md, verify_models.py) and vendor bundle, with generated guide containing exactly one T2-phrase match
